He (Forbes) was sitting with several other patients, and as part of my administration's roster system, I was on duty Tuesday/Wednesday night for overnight triage, so I was there and carried out my responsibilities. Throughout the night, we reviewed 30 patients and found that, according to triage policy, only three were actual emergencies.
"So we call about one bundle of emergency patients first according to triage and the rest are second bucket, which is the urgent bucket, and then you have... the less urgent bucket. So with that large number of patients, we had to triage the system very diligently," Dr Dawes said.
